title: Ocean Life
description: Living in a fishing village on Mexico’s Baja California peninsula, photographer Nicolas Hahn noticed that the midday winds pushed all kinds of sea creatures close to shore. During one snorkeling session, he discovered this remarkable scene: a collection of mauve stingers, a type of small bioluminescent jellyfish. Hahn got stung a few times around his mask, but the pain was worth it. His underwater lens captured every last tentacle in astonishing detail. This photo is featured in the "In Focus" series in the July 2026 issue of National Geographic.
translated_description: 居住在墨西哥下加利福尼亚半岛的一个渔村，摄影师尼古拉斯·哈恩注意到午后的风将各种海洋生物推向岸边。在一次浮潜中，他发现了这一非凡景象：一群紫纹水母，这是一种小型生物发光水母。哈恩的面罩周围被蜇了几次，但这份疼痛是值得的。他的水下镜头以惊人的细节捕捉到了每一根触须。这张照片刊登在《国家地理》2026年7月刊的“焦点”系列中。
